question: Which country beat India in the men's hockey semi-final event at Tokyo Olympics, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belgium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the Tokyo Olympics, the Indian women’s hockey team scripted history by qualifying for the Olympic Games semifinals for the first time,** on 2 August 2021.**
 
• This comes a day after, Indian Men’s Hockey team entered the **Olympic semifinals after four decades beating Great Britain 3-1.**
 
• However, the men's team lost to Belgium__ in the semifinals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• TOKYO OLYMPICS

 
 
• The 2020 Olympics was held in Tokyo from 23 July to 8 August 2021.
 
• The International Olympics Committee postponed the games due to Covid-19.
 
• This was the second time When Japan will host the Olympics. (First in 1964)
 
• Miraitowa is the official mascot of the 2020 Summer Olympics.
 
• The mascot is created by Japanese artist Ryo Taniguchi.
 
 
 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC)
 
 
• IOC is a not-for-profit independent international organization.
 
• Created- 23 June 1894
 
• The first Olympic Games of the modern era were conducted in April 1896.
 
• The Olympic Charter is the codification of the Fundamental Principles of Olympism.
 
• President- Thomas Bach
 
 
 
• Olympic Motto- CITIUS – ALTIUS - FORTIUS meaning (FASTER - HIGHER - STRONGER -COMMUNITER)
 
• The 138th session of the International Olympic Committee met between 20-21 July 2021.
 
• At this meeting, the International Olympic Committee decided to change the Olympic motto 'Citius, Altius, Fortius' to 'Citius, Altius, Fortius, Communiter'.
